Groups.Name: Main
Groups.DisplayName: Mod Compatibility (said mods must be placed below Sound Overhaul Pack)

Elements.Name: IncludeDir14
Description:
Adds default gameplay and object sounds on top using the Inugami Korone Collaboration DLC sounds.
Choose your desired sound preset according to your selected in in the Gameplay category.

Note(s):
- You are required to have the Inugami Korone Collaboration DLC mod in order to make it work and place it below Sound Overhaul Pack.

Same for Sonic Emote with Koco DLC!

Elements.Name: IncludeDir13
Elements.DisplayName: Sonic Emote with Koco DLC Language
Description:
Choose your desired language for the Sonic Emote with Koco DLC.

Note(s):
- You are required to have the Sonic Emote with Koco DLC mod in order to make it work and place it below Sound Overhaul Pack.

Same for Inugami Korone Collaboration DLC!

Elements.Name: IncludeDir0
Description: Enables compatibility support for Hypernova's Aggro Titans mod.

Elements.Name: BoostGrunt
Description:
Restores the energetic boost grunts Sonic used to make when boosting in previous titles. Also applies to Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

Note(s):
- Does not apply to Super Sonic, nor to Tails/Knuckles/Amy's Power Boosts.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir7
Description: Sets the language Super Sonic speaks during the Titan sequences - or mutes them so he stays silent, as in the vanilla game.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir5
Description: Sets the language Sonic speaks during Guardian intros - or mutes them so he stays silent, as in the vanilla game.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir10
Elements.DisplayName: The End's Monologue in Another Story
Description: Enables or disables The End's spoken monologue in Another Story.

Elements.Name: DrowningJingle
Description:
Plays the classic drowning jingle when you stay underwater too long, instead of only when trapped in an Aquaball (Balloon) on Rhea and Ouranos. The chosen jingle also plays inside the Aquaball.

Inspired by Weezley's mod.

Elements.Name: DrowningAlertJingle
Description: Restores the rising drowning-alert beeps that warn you while you've been underwater - or trapped in an Aquaball - for too long.

Elements.Name: HomingReticle
Description: Sets the sound that plays when you lock on with the homing reticle. Pick a style from across the series, or mute it.

Elements.Name: RestoreCameraGaze
Description: Restores an unused jingle meant to play when you press the stick to focus the camera (Camera Gaze) on a locked-on target.

Elements.Name: ZeroRingWarning
Description:
Restores an unused warning jingle meant to play when you reach zero rings.

Note(s):
- Plays only when you hit zero rings after taking damage.
- It normally plays when you begin the tutorial; it will not conflict with the 'Keep Rings from Cyber Space on Islands' code.

Fun fact: the same sound was later reused in Shadow Generations.

Elements.Name: AcceleCombo
Description:
Gives Sonic unique punch and kick sounds during melee combat.

Idea by Moke.

Elements.Name: ForcesSpin
Description:
Adds a spin sound when jumping and bouncing, like Sonic Forces. In Frontiers this normally only plays when jumping off an enemy.

Note(s):
- Does not apply to the Double Jump.
- Also plays for Amy, but only when she jumps out of a Spin Dash, since she doesn't normally curl into a ball.

Elements.Name: SpinDashImpact
Description: Adds the Spin Dash / Roll release sound from Sonic Lost World, with mod compatibility and an optional Drop Dash variant.

Elements.Name: LightDashImpact
Description: Adds the Light Dash sound from the Adventure titles.

Elements.Name: BoostJet
Description: Restores the jet 'whoosh' that plays while boosting, like in previous titles. Can be limited to Power Boost only or Cyber Space only.

Elements.Name: BoostJetSound
Description:
Selects which Boost Jet sound to use (Legacy or Frontiers).

Note(s):
- 'Restore Boost Jet' must be enabled for this to work.

Elements.Name: SonicDriftBoost
Description: Adds a boost sound when Sonic presses Boost during a Drift, instead of staying silent - just like previous titles.

Elements.Name: QuickStep
Description: Restores the Quick Step sound from previous titles. Choose which game's Quick Step sound to use.

Elements.Name: SkyDiveUnleashed
Description: Adds the high-quality Sky Dive (falling) sounds from the Hedgehog Engine 1 era (Sonic Unleashed).

Elements.Name: AmyDoubleJumpNEXT
Description: Adds an extra jump sound for Amy, as in Sonic the Hedgehog (2006). Use the double jump sound, the Tarot card propeller jump sound, or both.

Elements.Name: AmyDrift
Description: Adds drift sounds for Amy's Tarot Bike Drift.

Elements.Name: CyberAuraFriends
Description: Adds Tails, Knuckles, and Amy's Cyber Ghost aura sound from the cutscenes into gameplay.

Elements.Name: SuperTrans
Description: Adds transformation and detransformation sounds for Super Sonic. Designed to be used with the 'Super Sonic' and 'SS Transformation Effects' mods - both must be placed below Sound Overhaul Pack, or these sounds won't play.

Elements.Name: SuperSonicBoostPrimary
Description:
Gives Super Sonic a unique boost sound instead of reusing the default one.

Note: this is the boost sound from Sonic Generations / Lost World / Forces.

Elements.Name: SuperSonicBoostSecondary
Description:
Gives Super Sonic a unique boost sound instead of reusing the default one.

Note: this is the boost sound from Sonic Unleashed's Perfect Dark Gaia fight.

Elements.Name: SuperSonicDrift
Description: Gives Super Sonic a unique drift sound.

Elements.Name: SS2Aura
Description:
Brings Super Sonic 2's (normally hard-to-hear) aura from the cutscenes and quick-time events into gameplay.

Note(s):
- The aura may also play in a few scenarios (e.g. when The End reconnects its cable to Supreme); a fix isn't known yet.
- It plays for a few seconds after Supreme's defeat (during the black screen) but stops once the final cutscene begins.

Elements.Name: GrandSlamGiganto
Description: Adds Giganto's pained roar when it is hit by Super Sonic's Grand Slam.

Elements.Name: GrandSlamSupreme
Description:
Adds Supreme's pained roar when it is hit by Super Sonic's Grand Slam.

Note(s):
- Applies to regular Supreme only.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir1
Description: Choose the sound preset of your liking for Sonic.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir2
Description: Choose the sound preset of your liking for Tails.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir3
Description: Choose the sound preset of your liking for Knuckles.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir4
Description: Choose the sound preset of your liking for Amy.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir15
Description:
Choose the sound preset of your liking for the game objects

Note(s):
- You must follow each of your characters' selected preset to use the option that is suited for it in order to make it work and sound properly.

-This applies to general objects and Sonic's Birthday Bash.

Elements.Name: SpinDashSound
Description:
Choose which game's Spin Dash sounds to use, covering both the charge-up and the release.

Note(s):
- This same preset also determines the charge sound used for the Grand Slam finisher and Spin Slash.

Elements.Name: SpinDashAirSound
Description: Choose a unique sound to play while charging the Spin Dash in mid-air, layered on top of whichever preset is selected for Spin Dash above.

Elements.Name: DropDashAirSound
Description: Choose a unique sound to play while charging the Drop Dash, layered on top of whichever preset is selected for Spin Dash above.

Elements.Name: SpinDashChargeFaithful
Description:
Layers Sonic Frontiers' aerial charge-pose sound on top of the Spin Dash charge sound for a closer match to the original.

Note(s):
- Only works with the Sonic Frontiers or Sonic Unleashed Spin Dash presets.
- Stops while airborne, unless Aerial Spin Dash Charge is set to Unchanged.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir6
Description: Determine if you wish to keep ''Mystery Girl'' or replace it with each Titan's instrumental theme when encountering them for the first time.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir8
Description: Choose the boss theme for The End.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir9
Description: Determine which version of Ouranos Island you wish to play when in Another Story.
